description: Compare business formation counts across multiple industries for a given year. Great for spotting which sectors are growing fastest. Optionally filter by SSIC codes.

ssic_codes.description: List of SSIC codes to compare (e.g. ['62', '70', '47']). If omitted, returns all industries sorted by formations.

year.description: Year to compare. Defaults to latest available.

name: sg_formations_compare
